blind.description: A sturdy rustic wooden workbench featuring a thick planked tabletop, four thick square legs with block feet, a lower storage shelf, and a dark iron/metal woodworking vise attached to one front corner. The texture is stylized hand-painted wood grain in dark brown with mossy/weathered undertones and dark metallic hardware. Surfaces are clean, solid, and structurally sound with no floating or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden tabletop constructed from three rustic planks running horizontally, with the metallic vise mechanism protruding from the right-hand edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands around 2.5 feet tall (roughly knee-height to mid-thigh of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet long.
